name: Robert Montgomery Presents
description: Robert Montgomery Presents is an American dramatic television series which was produced by NBC from January 30, 1950 until June 24, 1957. The live show had several sponsors during its seven-year run, and the title was altered to feature the sponsor, usually Lucky Strike cigarettes, for example, Robert Montgomery Presents Your Lucky Strike Theater, ....The Johnson's Wax Program, and so on.

videos.title: The Letter
videos.overview: On a rubber plantation in Singapore, a woman convinces her husband and lawyer that the murder she committed was in self-defense. Her story begins to unravel when an incriminating letter surfaces.

videos.title: Kitty Foyle
videos.overview: A young girl is determined to improve her social status and marry a young man who's a part of society. His family has great objections.

videos.title: The Male Animal
videos.overview: A college professor faces being labeled a Communist for including "subversive" literature in his classes.

videos.title: The Egg and I
videos.overview: A husband surprises his new bride by purchasing a run-down chicken farm and moving them to the country. She has a hard time adjusting to a bucolic life and their pesky rustic neighbors Ma and Pa Kettle.

videos.title: Ride the Pink Horse
videos.overview: Lucky Gagin is an enigmatic stranger who arrives in the New Mexico border town of San Pablo to blackmail a gangster. Also involved is an FBI agent and a teen-aged Mexican girl who has visions of death.

videos.title: Our Town
videos.overview: Life is simple in the small town of Grover's Corners, New Hampshire. The story examines the circle of life of the town's residents who are born there, live their lives, and then pass away.

videos.title: The Phantom Lady
videos.overview: A man who's suffering an unhappy marriage spends the evening with a woman at a bar. Upon returning home, he finds his wife murdered. He's the lead suspect and no one remembers seeing the barfly who could provide his alibi.

videos.title: Pitfall
videos.overview: The life of John Forbes, an insurance company executive, becomes more exciting when he encounters Mona Stevens. Her jailed boyfriend robbed a business insured by the Forbes' company. When he goes to see Mona to collect the stolen loot, he falls hard for the femme fatale.

videos.title: Rebecca
videos.overview: The timid second wife of Maxim de Winter must compete with the sinister presence of his late first wife. At his manor, Manderley, Rebecca continues to dominate the lives of those who live in the large home.

videos.title: The Champion
videos.overview: Midge Kelly goes West and falls into a professional boxing career. Seduced by the fame and money, he becomes a star in the ring but a monster in real life.

videos.title: The Citadel
videos.overview: A young, idealistic doctor fails in his attempt to establish a useful practice. He learns he can make a lucrative living simply catering to the would-be ailments of the rich.

videos.title: The Awful Truth
videos.overview: Rumors of infidelity in her first marriage threaten Lucy Satterly impending nuptials. She asks her ex-husband to tell her fiancé that she never strayed. He agrees, though he believes he's lying thorough his teeth. Complicating matters is the arrival of the man who was supposedly her secret lover.

videos.title: The Big Sleep
videos.overview: A dying man hires private dick Philip Marlowe to keep an eye on his trouble-prone youngest daughter. In the process, he falls for her older sister. The job takes an interesting turn as Marlowe suddenly finds himself on a murder case.

videos.title: Arrowsmith
videos.overview: Dr. Arrowsmith works his way up the medical ladder to become a respected scientist who discovers how to kill bacteria. He is sent along with his wife to the Caribbean to stop the bubonic plague.

videos.title: The Petrified Forest
videos.overview: A failed writer who's hitchhiking wanders into an Arizona diner and befriends a young girl whose family runs the business. Events take an unexpected turn withe the arrival of a killer who takes everyone hostage.

videos.title: The Canterville Ghost
videos.overview: A young girl moves with her family into ancient Canterville Hall, and begins seeing a ghost. The spirit is that of Sir Simon de Canterville, an ancestor from the 17th century cursed because of an act of cowardice during his life.

videos.title: The Philadelphia Story
videos.overview: In this screwball comedy, a wealthy Philadelphia socialite's impending marriage is complicated by blackmail, a tabloid reporter, an ex-husband, drinking, and many misunderstandings.

videos.title: Mrs. Mike
videos.overview: A young Boston woman is sent to live with her uncle in the wilds of Canada. While there, she falls in love with and marries Mike Flannagan, a Mountie. The hardships of frontier life spent with the man she loves proves to be exciting and fulfilling for Mrs. Mike.

videos.title: Kiss And Tell
videos.overview: An average American teen-aged girl, Corliss Archer, vows to keep her mouth closed about her brother's secret marriage.

videos.title: Victoria Regina
videos.overview: Helen Hayes recreates her famed Broadway role in this adaptation of the Laurence Housman play. This dramatic biography offers insight into the life of the beloved Queen Victoria beginning with her ascension to the throne in 1837.

videos.title: Quicksand
videos.overview: A young man finds himself sinking deeper in the "quicksand" of suspicion and fear.

videos.title: A Star is Born
videos.overview: Young unknown Esther Blodgett comes to Hollywood to be a star and marries matinée idol Norman Maine. As her popularity begins to rise, he follows a downward path into oblivion thanks to his alcoholism.

videos.title: The Last Tycoon
videos.overview: A Hollywood film producer seems to be living the American dream. Though he has an impressive career, he suffers health problems and is not married to the woman he really loves.

videos.title: The Young in Heart
videos.overview: The Carlton family are impostors--con artists who make their living with shady card games and mooching off of rich suckers. Traveling by train, they latch onto lonely and rich old Miss Fording, saving her life during a derailment. Full of gratitude, she invites them to live with her in London home. The Carltons believe they have finally struck it rich.

videos.title: Dark Victory
videos.overview: A wealthy young society woman faces blindness and death when she's diagnosed with a brain tumor. Thinking she's cured, she falls in love with and marries the doctor who performed her surgery. Later, she suffers an emotional breakdown upon learning that she has just months to live.

videos.title: Stairway to Heaven
videos.overview: In this fantasy, a pilot learns that his life has been predetermined to end at a certain time. He temporarily evades his fate because of a snafu on the part of his heavenly emissary and his love of a WAC.

videos.title: The Bishop's Wife
videos.overview: A bishop has become obsessed with building a new cathedral and asks heaven for some help. The angel sent to Earth to help the bishop ends up falling in love with his wife.

videos.title: Ladies in Retirement
videos.overview: A retired actress' housekeeper also cares for her two deranged, older sisters. It's not long before the actress regrets allowing the loonies into her home as murder and blackmail follow.

videos.title: The House of Seven Gables
videos.overview: Fighting over an inheritance, one Pyncheon brother frames the other for murder.

videos.title: For Love or Money
videos.overview: In this comedy, a young woman seeks shelter during a thunderstorm at the country home of middle aged actor Preston Mitchell. She stays on as his secretary and the two eventually fall in love.

videos.title: Three O'Clock
videos.overview: Convinced that his wife is having an affair, a husband plants a bomb that will kill her and destroy the house. Before he can leave, a couple of burglars break in and tie him to a post in the basement as the clock on the bomb ticks away.

videos.title: When We are Married
videos.overview: In this comedy, a church organist has been a little too forward in his courting a young woman for three stuffy leaders of the church. They lecture the young man who, in turn, reveals a secret about each of the men's marriages.

videos.title: Bubbles
videos.overview: A young girl is nervous about the return of her mother from a mental institution, so her father buys her a kitten to calm her. Unfortunately, when the mother arrives, the daughter pays more attention to Bubbles than to her.

videos.title: I am Still Alive
videos.overview: In this comedy of mistaken identity, a blonde knocks a driver unconscious when she rear-ends his car with hers. She can't find any identification on him; the only clue is a script that indicates he's a spy.

videos.title: To Walk the Night
videos.overview: College friends Bark and Jerry discover their old friend Professor LeNormand dead in his observatory, burned to death from the inside out. Most shocking, the confirmed bachelor had just married an enigmatic woman who seems unfazed by his death. Within days, Jerry is engaged to marry the mysterious widow, leading Bark to believe she was somehow involved in the professor's death.

videos.title: I Wouldn't Want to Be in Your Shoes
videos.overview: Unusual circumstances befall a hapless man who's missing a pair of shoes, leading to his involvement in a murder.

videos.title: An Inspector Calls
videos.overview: A suspicious inspector investigates the murder of a young woman who was part of a respectable middle-class British family. He uncovers bizarre motivations among the family members before he's revealed to be an impostor.

videos.title: The Kimballs
videos.overview: Steve LaFarge visits the small town of his childhood and meets the current residents of the house in which he played. He falls in love with the daughter, Ann Kimball, but is given the cold shoulder by her aloof father. Old man Kimball has been bitter ever since the murder of his wife 15 years earlier. Steve is shocked by the realization that he may have been involved in the woman's death.

videos.title: Top Secret
videos.overview: A foreign service agent brings along his young adult daughter on a mission, traveling to a country on the verge of a revolution.

videos.title: A Christmas Gift
videos.overview: This holiday love story set in war-torn Sognac, France involves a French underground fighter, an American lieutenant, and a lovely, young maiden.

videos.title: The Farmer's Hotel
videos.overview: While their car is being repaired, man and woman stop by the Farmer's Hotel to use their phone. It happens to be the hotel's opening night and they're joined by the business manager and staff, an intoxicated truck driver, a doctor, and three vaudevillians. Everyone's having a delightful time until an argument starts.

videos.title: Cashel Byron's Profession
videos.overview: In 1867 London, boxer Cashel Byron woos cultured aristocrat Lydia Carew. He attempts to keep his sorted profession, illegal at the time, a secret from the priggish woman.

videos.title: The Tender Men
videos.overview: A farm boy from the country moves to the big city to make his mark. When he ends up broke and hungry, he proves an easy target for the Communist party.

videos.title: Eva? Caroline?
videos.overview: Police in Detroit have charged Eva Lang with committing a murder several years earlier. She claims that she is, in reality, is Caroline, the wife of a Baltimore lawyer. Even though she produces 28 witnesses to validate her claim, the lawyer says his wife is deceased.

videos.title: Rise Up And Walk
videos.overview: Turnley Walker, at six feet and 200 pounds, is struck with polio at age 30. This true drama is based on his book which chronicles his courage as he battles the dread disease.

videos.title: The Moonstone
videos.overview: When a valuable gem is stolen from a Buddhist temple, the priests place a curse on the object. The gem's original owner ends up dead and the rock disappears.

videos.title: Those in Favor
videos.overview: This Cold War political drama concerns a U.N. meeting in Paris and the relationship between the U.S. and Soviet delegates.

videos.title: Storm
videos.overview: A freak storm originates on the West Coast and travels across the county, and the weather bureau tracks it along its path. The stories of various people affected by the violent weather are dramatized by a cast of forty-plus.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, George
videos.overview: During WWII, an American soldier celebrates three of his birthdays, each with a different woman; one is British, one an American and one is Belgian. As the episode closes, the now-older soldier is surrounded by his children who are awaiting the arrival of their mother. The mystery is which one of those three women will arrive.

videos.title: Guardian of the Clock
videos.overview: In this comedy/drama, a maintenance man plays a practical joke and changes the time on a huge skyscraper's outdoor clock. Because of his little prank, several people's lives are unexpectedly changed that evening.

videos.title: The Wall
videos.overview: Lording over a decaying New England manor, a woman is visited by her brother and his new wife and her devious ex-sister-in-law. A murder soon follows.

videos.title: Claire Ambler
videos.overview: A 1920s flapper has her faith in her father completely shattered, starting her on a path of destructive revenge.

videos.title: See No Evil
videos.overview: Excitement finally comes into the boring life of a man when he witnesses a murder. Being the lead witness for the state, even more intrigue arrives in the form of a letter threatening him and his family with violence.

videos.title: O Evening Star
videos.overview: It's the 1920s and Amy Bellaire is already becoming a has-been. She split with the man who made her famous and is now she's broke. The humiliation mounts as she attends an auction of her expensive personal belongings.

videos.title: Operation Hitch-Hike
videos.overview: In this tale of World War II espionage, German soldiers disguised as GI's cross American lines to sabotage ammunition dumps. Three of the men, while hitch-hiking, are given a lift by a Red Cross worker. When a storm comes up, the woman's forced to take refuge with them in a farmhouse.

videos.title: And Never Come Back
videos.overview: Two ex-wives of the same man are aboard a train heading to Los Angeles. The goal of both is to reunite with their former husband. Only one of the women makes it to their L.A. destination.

videos.title: The Truth About Blayds
videos.overview: Lying on his death bed, famous poet Oliver Blayds reveals startling secrets from earlier in life.

videos.title: The Lonely
videos.overview: An American pilot falls for a young British woman during World War II.

videos.title: Lila, My Love
videos.overview: A reporter for a Paris newspaper encounters an American woman with great ambitions.

videos.title: The Longest Night
videos.overview: An ambitious pianist hurt by the lack of love from her mother chooses a music career over the man who loves her. She returns years later as a successful performer to find her former love is now married and running for the governorship.

videos.title: The Ringmaster
videos.overview: A one-time actor suffered a crippling injury early in his career. Now managing a inn, he takes great delight in influencing the lives of his guests--in negative ways.

videos.title: Candles for Theresa
videos.overview: Following World War II, American painter Richard Clyde travels to a French village that was occupied by the Germans. His purpose is to find the traitor who caused his brother to be murdered by the Nazis. Richard finds the residents battered and distrustful of himself and each other.

videos.title: Penny
videos.overview: An understanding father deals with the trials and tribulations of having a 15-year-old daughter.

videos.title: Of Lena Geyer
videos.overview: Real-life soprano diva Mimi Benzell plays the role of an opera star whose romance comes to a bitter end, leaving her to vow never to again mix love and work. Benzell performs "La Traviata," "Mmme. Butterfly," and "Tannhauser."

videos.title: Til Next We Meet
videos.overview: A wealthy but unhappy woman meets a hard-boiled newspaper reporter and sets out to prove that she has as much love within her as she has money.

videos.title: King of the Castle
videos.overview: In this dramatic comedy, the last in a long line of Scottish lords goes to great measures to avoid the family curse.

videos.title: Sheppy
videos.overview: Sheppey is an English barber who wins big playing the Irish sweepstakes and decides to spread his wealth among the poor and sick. Along the way, he meets an impoverished shop girl in a local pub.

videos.title: The Catbird Seat
videos.overview: For thirty years, Erwin Martin has been an exemplary employee as head of the filing department at an advertising agency. His orderly world could be disrupted when the company brings in an efficiency expert. Martin uses his quiet, mild manner to circumvent the flashy "expert" and leave her powerless over him.

videos.title: Advice to the Lovelorn
videos.overview: A newspaper publisher who has no time for love hires a psychology professor to write the "Advice to the Lovelorn" column in his paper. Before he knows it, he's fallen in love with the columnist.

videos.title: Mr. Dobie Takes a Powder
videos.overview: The manager of the household furnishings section of a department store rebels when the company forces an efficiency expert on him.

videos.title: Summer Story
videos.overview: An employee at a travel agency is given a dream vacation by a co-worker who won it but can't use it. Living it up in a swanky hotel, her troubles begin when she starts hanging out with a playboy.

videos.title: Stand-In Bride
videos.overview: A gown designer's assistant delivers a dress to the governor who's planning a secret wedding. When word of their nuptials is leaked to the press, the woman has an idea for distracting the reports. After the ceremony, she'll don the gown, the governor's aide will wear a tux, and the two will act as decoys.

videos.title: Nostradamus Beery
videos.overview: In this comedy, a man has the ability to predict various events--some important, some trivial. Once a reporter catches wind of his talent, the publicity turns his life into a circus.

videos.title: Unclouded Summer
videos.overview: An American traveling abroad falls in love with an already married British noblewoman.

videos.title: The Law Abiding
videos.overview: An operative of the U.S. government has the task of spying on Dr. Anton Radjak, a Czech scientist, who's snooping around London. He's very interested in stealing the new discovery made by U.S. and Great Britain scientists.

videos.title: The Fairfield Lady
videos.overview: An ambitious woman is determined to rise to the top of the publishing business and will not let anything, or anyone, stand in her way. An ambitious woman is determined to rise to the top of the publishing business and will not let anything, or anyone, stand in her way.

videos.title: There Once Was a Diamond Ring
videos.overview: A man, still in love with his wife, tries to save his crumbling marriage by giving her a diamond ring. She could care less and loses it down the drain. A plumber eventually finds the ring as it begins a trip stretching over several thousand miles. Everyone who comes in contact with the piece of jewelry finds happiness.

videos.title: Precinct
videos.overview: A police lieutenant working in a big city department takes his duties seriously. He is so dedicated, in fact, that he neglects his 18-year-old son who becomes involved in drugs.

videos.title: Senora Isobel
videos.overview: A rising political figure faces a crisis at home thanks to years of neglecting his wife while pursuing his career.

videos.title: The Fall Guy
videos.overview: A college football star is offered a lucrative contract to play in the professional leagues. He's torn between going for the sports career or staying in school and entering a more stable career. His girlfriend votes for school.

videos.title: Keane vs. Keane
videos.overview: A wealthy heiress discovers that her husband was merely a gold-digger so she sues him for divorce.

videos.title: The Sheffield Story
videos.overview: A trusted German general during World War II was actually a secret agent for the British.

videos.title: The Bench in the Park
videos.overview: A man's sour outlook on life brings about important changes in the lives of those who encounter him.

videos.title: The Biarritz Scandal
videos.overview: An American loses everything gambling in a French casino. This leads to his involvement in a dangerous scheme.

videos.title: The Davidian Report
videos.overview: A secret document known as the "Davidian Report" smuggled out of Berlin and for sale to the highest bidder. In this spy tale set on a flight from New York to Los Angeles, any one of the passengers may be after the report; it's wanted by everyone from the FBI to the Communists.

videos.title: The Valari Special
videos.overview: An Italian racer is distraught after learning that he has been replaced. The race team went with someone younger--his own son. His mechanic still has faith in "old man" Valeri and builds another car for him to race.

videos.title: The Post Road
videos.overview: Emily Madison owns a Connecticut tourist home on Boston's Post Road. One night, mysterious Dr. Spender arrives with his nurse, chauffeur and a patient--a young woman who surprisingly gives birth. The household members become suspicious when they're kept from seeing the baby for a week, and they hear on the radio that an infant has been kidnapped from its cradle.

videos.title: The Inward Eye
videos.overview: A mother is caught up in a bizarre case of mistaken identity that results in her seven-year-old son being kidnapped.

videos.title: Victory
videos.overview: A baron living on a remote South Pacific island seldom travels to the mainland. On a rare occasion that he does, he rescues a girl from her job working for a hateful hotel owner. The two live happily ever after...until the the hotelier sends a couple of thugs to bring the girl back.

videos.title: The Christmas Cards
videos.overview: A lonely man purchases three Christmas cards and mails each to someone chosen at random.

videos.title: The Closed Door
videos.overview: Detective Peter Handley is in the hospital for treatment of a memory block after his girlfriend is found murdered. He's unable to recall if he did or didn't kill the young woman so he is administered sodium amytal, the "truth serum."

videos.title: Keep Your Head Up, Mr. Putnam
videos.overview: This episode is based on the autobiography of Peter Putnam, a young man who lost his sight in a hunting accident. Wanting to pursue his education, he attends the Seeing Eye Institute in Morristown, New Jersey before attending and graduating from Princeton University.

videos.title: Ricochet
videos.overview: A sleazy reporter makes his name exposing the skeletons in other people's closets. Eventually, all of his dirt-digging backfires on him.

videos.title: Maggie, Pack Your Bags
videos.overview: An ex-Army officer is enjoying his retirement in Mexico with his second wife--until his son and a general arrive to disrupt his quiet life.

videos.title: The Outer Limit
videos.overview: The military sends up a pilot in a rocket-boosted plane to reach the outer limit of the atmosphere. They lose communication with him as he travels beyond their radar's upper range. He's presumed dead, yet he lands safely an hour after he would have run out of oxygen and fuel.

videos.title: Element of Risk
videos.overview: While taking a supposedly relaxing country vacation, a famous actor gets anything but rest. His gorgeous next door neighbor has just been acquitted of murdering her husband. The actor starts asking questions about the case and finds himself in serious danger.

videos.title: The Shadow Line
videos.overview: A young sailor who's had his fill of the sailing life announces his retirement from the sea. For his final voyage, he agree to captain a ship back home from the Siam Sea.

videos.title: The Burtons
videos.overview: The owner of a carriage shop in 1910 New England is informed that his business stands in the path of a proposed new highway. he chooses to ignore the state's orders and refuses to vacate.

videos.title: Dinah, Kip, and Mr. Barlow
videos.overview: A man from a small town, a career woman, and an unemployed-but-talented older man are each unknowingly competing for the same advertising agency job. The two younger people end up falling in love but their relationship starts takes a back seat to professional competition.

videos.title: Betrayed
videos.overview: The widow of a Korean war soldier works in an isolated mountain laboratory where research on atomic weapons is being conducted. She befriends a couple that tells her that her husband is not dead, but being held by the Communists. They offer a deal: in exchange for atomic secrets, they will insure his safe return.

videos.title: The Centrifuge
videos.overview: A research scientist joins a team working at a secret lab in Britain. Their project is to beat the Communists in developing deadly bacteria for use in biological warfare. The doctor inadvertently becomes involved in espionage.

videos.title: Tomorrow We'll Sing
videos.overview: A United States airman tries to change the resentment that Italians villagers have towards Americans during their occupation of the town in World War II.

videos.title: The Big Night
videos.overview: A former pilot in the Air Force finds it tough making the adjustment to the boring life of the civilian world.

videos.title: Burden of Proof
videos.overview: In a British courtroom, a spoiled son is on trial for the murder of his father. Also on hand are his shrewish wife and loving daughter.

videos.title: Second-Hand Sofa
videos.overview: After recovering from a nervous breakdown, Lacey Holden and her husband, Gates, move into an apartment in the city. The previous tenant is in a hurry to catch a boat out of the country and sells her old sofa to the couple. Lacey seems happy and healthy until she fines a note stashed in the sofa that reads, "If I am missing, I have been killed on this sofa."

videos.title: The Glass Gage
videos.overview: Adam Foster is such a punctual and predictable employee that co-workers refer to him as "Mr. Tick Tock, the Human Clock". Everyone is surprised when the meticulous man is accused of embezzling company funds. A secretary in the office who has been put off by his blandness is the one person who can help him clear his name.

videos.title: World by the Tail
videos.overview: In this romantic comedy, a ballerina and foreign attaché call off their romance. So do the ballerina's roommate and her boyfriend. The two lovers who just got dumped happen to meet.

videos.title: Summer Tempest
videos.overview: A war widow must decide whether to live in the past or begin a new life in the present. She faces serious objections on re-marriage from the mother-in-law of her late husband.

videos.title: Linda
videos.overview: Broadway star Linda Coles gives the performance of a lifetime to the press when her husband dies in a small plane crash. What they don't know is that Linda and her husband's best friend, her lover, are behind the tragedy.

videos.title: Appointment in Samarra
videos.overview: Set against the middle upper class of a small Pennsylvania town in 1930, a man's world self-destructs as the Great Depression takes its toll.

videos.title: The Wind Cannot Read
videos.overview: A pilot for the Royal Air Force is lucky to be alive after his plane goes down in a Burmese jungle. While in India during World War II, he falls in love with his Japanese tutor.

videos.title: All Things Glad and Beautiful
videos.overview: The story of a devoted mother and her son is told from his birth until he becomes a GI during World War II.

videos.title: No Head for Midnight
videos.overview: This light comedy chronicles the romantic misadventures of an airline pilot on vacation at the beach. Before it's over, he's proposed to two different women, one right after the other.

videos.title: The Woman Who Hated Children
videos.overview: A woman wants to have nothing to do with any children following the death of her son. Concerned over his wife's continued grief, her husband warms up to a friendly tyke from the slums.

videos.title: Half a Kingdom
videos.overview: One man convinces the rest of the jury to vote "not-guilty" on charges against a wealthy industrialist. Now, he feels the cleared man owes him big.

videos.title: The Half Millionaire
videos.overview: A boarding house is the setting for a murder, underworld criminals, the police, and $500,000 in cash.

videos.title: Two of a Kind
videos.overview: In this comedy, a husband does his best to prevent jealousy between his home and his office.

videos.title: A Summer Love
videos.overview: The star of a theater group, an aging Lothario with several marriages to his credit, falls for a younger actress in the cast. After meeting her family, he realizes that his past will stand in the way of their happiness. He pretends to romance one of his ex-wives so the girlfriend will be able to dump him.

videos.title: Anne's Story
videos.overview: Anne was raised in a tawdry environment and constantly overshadowed by her successful, sexy younger sister. She enrolls in an art class for relief from her drudgery and meets a handsome, but jaded, playboy. He finds her a breath of fresh air, but Anne can't believe a good-looking man would have any interest in her,

videos.title: Duet for Two Hands
videos.overview: A pianist has lost both of his hands in a tragic accident. A respected surgeon performs the impossible by grafting the hands of a recently-hanged killer onto the disabled musician. The musician's new hands prefer murdering to playing sonatas.

videos.title: Red Robin Rides Again
videos.overview: A woman who lives with her brother and his daughter decide to reach out across the ocean and invite a British exchange student to stay with them. The visitor is an American actor, posing as a Britain, who proceeds to charm the young daughter of the household. The girl's fiancé is jealous of the would-be European's class, even though he's no slouch himself.

videos.title: Pierce 3098
videos.overview: A husband who's carrying on an affair cannot get his wife to give him a divorce. Harold arranges for Alice to have an "accident"; he tampers with phone lines so that when he calls her from his office, there will be a deadly explosion. His well-engineered plan does not come off as expected.

videos.title: Grass Roots
videos.overview: An ex-military man from rural farm country runs for senator on a platform of cleaning up political corruption.

videos.title: First Vice-President
videos.overview: A hard-driving, domineering business executive is determined to become the company's next president. He invites the retiring chairman and his wife to his Long Island home to wine and dine his way into the position. The man's family members, who are fed up with his tyrannical control over them, finally stage a mutiny at the dinner party.

videos.title: Private Purkey's Private Place
videos.overview: A soldier and his buddies find themselves in Europe at the end of the war. Believing their opinions are as important as those of Army brass and politicians, they formulate their own peace plan and are determined to share it. They work their way into the Paris peace talks and Private Purkey makes sure the world hears his ideas.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: Dr. Robert Collis works to rehabilitate children, both physically and spiritually, who were held at Belsen, the notorious Nazi prison camp. He invests special efforts to win over Eva, who guards her younger brother so tightly that they can't treat his tuberculosis. This is based on actual events.

videos.title: September Time
videos.overview: Marion Shaw, a premiere concert vocalist, takes a forced summer rest in Cape Cod to give her strained voice a chance to recover. The truth slowly becomes obvious to both Marion and her voice coach that her singing days are over. The burden of losing her career is lightened by a handsome man she meets in the resort town.

videos.title: The Big Money
videos.overview: A World War I hero operates on the belief that money, and lots of it, buys happiness. He jumps into the airplane business, believing it will offer big bucks, but soon fails. He plunges into the stock market and meets a woman, but she soon leaves him because of his iffy finances. His single minded goal of money continues to negatively influence his career choices and his relationships.

videos.title: Breakdown
videos.overview: Scientist Philip Armstrong returns to England to conduct tests on a top secret government weapon. Dr. Allen, whom he doesn't know, is assigned to work with him. The doctor confides that he's in love with a woman he's just recently met. It turns out that the woman is Armstrong's wife. With the stress of his work and his marriage in shambles, the scientist is on the verge of a crack-up.

videos.title: A Criminal Assignment
videos.overview: Wanting to catch other criminals, the British secret service gains the release of a counterfeiter who's dropped into France. He is to produce bills that contain a tiny flaw to be used to pay off the suspected double-dealers. With the plan a success, the ex-con is free to go. Following the war, the counterfeiter disappears and authorities find two perfect plates. Clearly, he couldn't resist the temptation to print a little for himself.

videos.title: The Sunday Punch
videos.overview: A one-time big name fighter, Tony Marino, is on his way down the boxing ladder, but he still can throw his powerful "Sunday punch." Tony's manager tries to bribe him to take a dive in a fight with up-and-comer Kid Walker. Tony is infuriated and almost wins the fight, though he suffers a dangerous head injury that could have lasting repercussions.

videos.title: Cakes and Ale
videos.overview: Upon the death of a famed writer, two colleagues competing to write his biography visit his country estate. While there, they meet a charming local barmaid, Rosie, with quite a story to tell: she had married an unsuccessful middle-aged writer and was a major influence that guided him to being a better man and noted author.

videos.title: No Picnic at Mount Kenya
videos.overview: Based on a true story from World War II, Felice Benuzzi was one of 10,000 prisoners of war held at the Kenya camp. Benuzzi and two others manage to escape by successfully scaling down the 17,000-foot high Mt. Kenya.

videos.title: Weekend Pass
videos.overview: A soldier on a three-day weekend pass is determined to paint the town. With $200 and his fiancé, he hits the nightspots in New York City. His girlfriend, though, soon tires of the party life and becomes irritated by his refusal to name a wedding date. After she storms off, he decides to connect with another girl, unaware of what adventures she has in store for him.

videos.title: The Deep Six
videos.overview: After far too many months at sea, tensions build among the men and officers of the cruiser U.S.S. Atlantis during World War II. Lt. Alec Austen is already irritated by the constant meddling of his executive and gunnery officers. After months of tedium and threatened danger, the ship encounters a Japanese force in the Aleutians and is thrust into a furious battle for survival.

videos.title: Harvest
videos.overview: A young man in love with a sophisticated woman from the city is torn between his desires and those of his family. His parents wish him and his brother to stay and work on their small Minnesota wheat farm while both want to escape the tough life and move to the city. It's up to the mother to keep the family together in spirit during their Thanksgiving holiday reunion.

videos.title: The Soprano and the Piccolo Player
videos.overview: An overweight piccolo player's accompaniment to a soprano's aria is so well-received that the two are suddenly in demand as a duo. As their fame and popularity grow, so does the piccolo player's love for his beautiful partner. As he's trying to muster up the courage to ask her to marry him, he learns that she has become engaged to another. Heartbroken, he disappears, never to be seen or heard from again.

videos.title: Really the Blues
videos.overview: Jackie Cooper stars in this biography of jazz great Milton "Mezz" Mezzrow. An unruly youth, his parents put him in a reform school where he first encountered jazz. He eventually became a talented clarinetist and fronted his own combo during the 1920s, but when music trends moved towards big bands, he suffered a rapid decline in fortunes. Mezz endured much mental suffering during this period before being reintroduced to the public by friends like musician Gene Krupa.

videos.title: No Visible Means
videos.overview: Tom, a smooth talking gigolo, makes the rounds through the speakeasies of 1920s New York. He's loved by Veronia, a woman with a lot of money, but he loses interest when he meets Iris. She presents herself as a person of society on the verge of big film career. Wedding plans quickly follow, until their lies catch up with both of them.

videos.title: What About Christmas?
videos.overview: Individuals throughout an American city end up touching one another in unexpected ways during the holiday season. Among the unrelated people are a lonely old man and his cat, a movie actor hoping to make it home for Christmas, a businessman, and a scientist who chooses to work in his lab on Christmas Eve.

videos.title: The Greatest Man in the World
videos.overview: A publicity-loving mechanic causes a sensation when he flies solo around the world. A newspaper reporter is assigned the job of uncovering this unknown person's secretive past.

videos.title: The Steady Man
videos.overview: A couple whose child died at birth face a problem adopting a child. The husband, proud of the fact that he can account for every penny they spend, is horrified by the expense and the long wait involved. It's up to the patient wife to talk her husband into dealing with the adoption process.

videos.title: A Case of Identity
videos.overview: While taking the subway home from the Stork Club, a musician is detained by police for a robbing a loan office. One of the clerks identifies him as the criminal and he's eventually sentenced to jail. It is only through the determination of his lawyer that he is finally freed.

videos.title: Machinal
videos.overview: Giving in to the advice of her calculating mother, Helen marries her highly successful and thoroughly revolting boss. Since his very touch repulses her, she ends up in an affair with a young man who eventually betrays her. The climax to her sad life is being sentenced to the electric chair.

videos.title: Richard Said No
videos.overview: A ad-man for a perfume company meets his female counterpart at a party when his jealous wife is away.

videos.title: The 17th of June
videos.overview: Based on a true story, a man performs heroic acts against Communists in East Berlin during an uprising on June 17th of the previous summer.

videos.title: Mr. Whittle and the Morning Star
videos.overview: After much study, a history professor has decided that the end of the world is upon us.

videos.title: Our Hearts Were Young and Gay
videos.overview: The adventures of the young Cornelia Otis Skinner and Emily Kimbrough are dramatized from the bestseller of the same title. The girls board a luxury ship bound for Europe and are flirted with by a couple of Yankees, but much prefer the company of two sophisticated society men.

videos.title: Land of Happiness
videos.overview: In 1895, a sophisticated woman of Copenhagen accompanies her husband, a pastor to his new parish. It's located on the rustic and isolated Faero Islands of the North Atlantic.

videos.title: Such a Busy Day Tomorrow
videos.overview: A senior citizen who's successfully raised a family feels he has nothing remaining to contribute to their lives. He meets a group of people at an senior center and fears he'll never be as happy again as they seem to be.

videos.title: The Paradise Cafe
videos.overview: A honky-tonk piano player with big plans is surrounded by a diverse group of dreamers in this character study set in a bistro.

videos.title: The Quality of Mercy
videos.overview: A couple innocently leave their baby home alone for a night out in the Big Apple. Authorities learn of this, take the child and place it in a children's home. Confused and frightened, the parents become violent, however the nun who heads the facility bestows mercy upon the couple.

videos.title: Pink Hippopotamus
videos.overview: A blockade runner, himself an escapee from behind the Iron Curtain, deals in the transport of human cargo in and out of that region. His current mission is to reunite a young boy and his parents.

videos.title: My Little Girl
videos.overview: A reporter father thinks he's done a good job of raising his child. Unfortunately, he starts to have doubts about her integrity.

videos.title: For These Services
videos.overview: Father and son physicians are at odds over how to practice medicine.

videos.title: The Pale Blonde of Sand Street
videos.overview: A young sailor meets a blonde and give her his lucky coin. With it, she makes a wish for him to disappear from her life. When the wish comes true, she begins to haunt ships looking for the man she really loves.

videos.title: Big Boy
videos.overview: The conflict between generations is played out between an old railroad man and his son over steam powered trains versus the new diesel engine.

videos.title: No Need of Favor
videos.overview: A young artist who has lost his vision falls for and marries his secretary, a woman of great inner beauty but "plain Jane" looks. When an operation restores the artists' sight, his wife becomes insecure because she can never match the vision of beauty he had of her in his mind.

videos.title: The Wages of Fear
videos.overview: Four men face danger at every turn driving truckloads of nitroglycerin through jungle country to Guatemala's to oil fields.

videos.title: Pilgrim's Pride
videos.overview: A businessman takes his number one client to the country for meetings, but finds his daughter already there with a house full of party guests.

videos.title: Sky Block
videos.overview: Farmland across the Midwest is turned into desert by someone wielding a destructive "drought machine".

videos.title: The Power and the Prize
videos.overview: When in Europe, an American businessman falls for a refugee from behind the Iron Curtain. He brings the girl back with him and must deal with the prejudices of the people he works with.

videos.title: Once Upon a Time
videos.overview: A bride and groom greeting guests at their wedding encounter loves from their pasts. Each remembers their dating days and thinks about the one they might have married.

videos.title: The Patriot from Antibes
videos.overview: A baron and baroness are swindled out of a small fortune by group of impressive con men in a true story from the Paris police files.

videos.title: Great Expectations: the Promise (Part 1)
videos.overview: In the first of this two-part adaptation, Pip, a young man with an inheritance, suffers through problems that arise due to his friendship with an escaped criminal.

videos.title: Great Expectations: the Reality (Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, Pip gets his own apartment, falls in love, and has another encounter with the criminal Magwitch.

videos.title: In His Hands
videos.overview: A young doctor's true love suffers an incurable, deadly disease.

videos.title: The Expert
videos.overview: A noted author and lecturer on the subject of marital bliss can not speak from personal experience. He has a hard time explaining why a strange woman in her pajamas is feeding him breakfast.

videos.title: Story on 11th Street
videos.overview: A lonely widower with a seven-year-old son wants to rebuild a happy home for the child.

videos.title: It Happened in Paris
videos.overview: An American couple broadcast a weekly radio show from Paris, enthralling their listeners back home with stories of their extended honeymoon in France. In reality, the man and woman are not married, can't stand each other, and bicker constantly. That's why they're unhappy when the sponsor wants to renew their contracts.

videos.title: Patricia
videos.overview: A young society woman follows her own path and enrolls in a bohemian art school. She immediately falls for an older instructor, but he does not return her affections.

videos.title: Home Town
videos.overview: A gullible man leaves his home town for the big city. He falls prey to a flashy public relations man who plots a big build-up for his debut.

videos.title: About Sara Caine
videos.overview: An overbearing young female reporter is determined to better her father, competing against him in the coverage of a news story.

videos.title: Invitation to Murder
videos.overview: A publisher gets a manuscript full of damning statements about a number of important people. He invites its author and those mentioned in the book to the same party, suggesting to his guests that murdering the author might be a suitable option.

videos.title: Personal Story
videos.overview: At the peak of his career, an architect suffers an heart attack. He takes the doctor's advice to slow down to such an extreme, he's barely living his life.

videos.title: A Matter of Luck
videos.overview: A singer is given a lucky charm by a girl in his neighborhood and his career suddenly takes off. When he accidentally breaks the trinket, his good luck ends just as abruptly.

videos.title: The People You Meet
videos.overview: In this comedy, the problems are worked out of a new play in Boston before it goes to Broadway.

videos.title: Ten Minute Alibi
videos.overview: A man could lose his girlfriend to a blackmailer who's making his life miserable. That prompts him to plot a murder.

videos.title: Diary
videos.overview: A small-town girl leaves her unhappy home to find her way in a large city. There she meets an unsavory character who, nevertheless, offers her the only understanding help she has ever known.

videos.title: A Dreamer of Summer
videos.overview: A Brooklyn bookkeeper falls in love with a Bronx shipping clerk at a summer resort. Meanwhile, each fears that the other will discover their secret; it seems they both exaggerated greatly about their careers.

videos.title: Two Wise Women
videos.overview: A married American banker falls for a French reporter while in Berlin.

videos.title: Autumn Crocus
videos.overview: When love finally arrives for a spinster school teacher, she must reject it. The young innkeeper she's fallen for is already married.

videos.title: A Foreign Affair
videos.overview: This comic romance begins in the post-war rubble of 1947 Berlin, Germany. Captain Pringle is in love with a U. S. Congresswoman on an investigation and the woman being investigated.

videos.title: Remote
videos.overview: In this fictional documentary, a man campaigning for the governorship of a Southern state goes on trial for the murder of his secretary. The effects of television coverage on justice are highlighted as facts get distorted along party lines and the cameras cover the "event" inside and outside the courtroom.

videos.title: The Gentleman
videos.overview: A man is obsessed with the way things used to be. Rather than accepting and appreciating the present, he sadly retreats to living his life in the past.

videos.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame (Part 1)
videos.overview: Subtitled "The Beastliness of Beauty", Victor Hugo's classic is adapted for television. It's the story of the hideous bell-ringing Quasimodo at the Cathederal of Notre Dame and the beautiful woman he loves, Esmeralda.

videos.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame (Part 2)
videos.overview: Subtitled The Beauty of the Beast, Victor Hugo's classic is adapted for the small screen. It's the story of the hideous bell-ringing Quasimodo at the Cathederal of Notre Dame and the beautiful woman he loves, Esmeralda.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: On the weekend of the big homecoming game, a college football star plans for an improved future. The rich co-ed he's dating could be his ticket to an upgrade in his status.

videos.title: Judith
videos.overview: Judith is a beautiful woman who proceeds to destroy the man she claims to have loved. She receives a well-earned retribution for her actions.

videos.title: Dr. Ed
videos.overview: This inspirational story is based on real-life physician Dr. Edward Conner of Pennsylvania. In his life, he was able to start a clinic for handicapped kids, despite his personal battle with multiple sclerosis.

videos.title: End of a Mission
videos.overview: A pilot who's thought to have died during a crash decides to "play dead" so he can remain near the woman he loves. Eventually, he wishes to return to the United States, as both a deserter and a casualty.

videos.title: David Copperfield: the Search (Part 1)
videos.overview: In the first of two parts, young and motherless David is sent by his uncaring stepfather to live with the impoverished Micawbers in London. He barely survives, working at a warehouse gluing labels on bottles.

videos.title: David Copperfield: the Reward (Part 2)
videos.overview: In the second of two parts, David conducts his romance with the spoiled Dora Spenlow and, with the help of Micawber, unmasks Uriah Heep as a scheming thief. This episode is subtitled "The Reward".

videos.title: Death and the Sky Above
videos.overview: An innocent man convicted for the murder of his wife escapes to search for the guilty party, but is ultimately recaptured. Back in the death house, the moments tick by as the time of his execution gets nearer.

videos.title: A Night for Dreaming
videos.overview: Three girls share a New York apartment, each with a dream they're pursuing. One wants to meet someone to love, one wants to marry a rich man, and last wishes to become a star. Each learns that their dreams come with high prices.

videos.title: The Cypress Tree
videos.overview: A widow tries to move on following the death of her husband, but her sisters stand in the way. One wants her to forge ahead while the other wants her to go into seclusion in memory of her departed spouse.

videos.title: Joe's Boy
videos.overview: A self-centered father is determined to see that his son, the soldier, gets married to a proper girl and starts a respectable career.

videos.title: Deadline
videos.overview: A small town girl moves to the city and falls in love with her ruthless, cut-throat boss. During the time she awaits his proposal, she transforms into a hard-boiled career woman. When she returns to her hometown, she finds she doesn't fit in anymore.

videos.title: The Lost Weekend
videos.overview: Robert Montgomery takes the starring role in this version of the famous film about a man slowly dying from alcoholism.

videos.title: The Breaking Point
videos.overview: A pre-med college professor, whose wife died on the operating table, makes exams especially difficult for his students. His aim is to weed out those unworthy of the trust of the medical profession.

videos.title: Coming of Age
videos.overview: Fears lead to upheaval in Terry Ballard's life as he suffers a mid-life crisis at his 40th birthday. His wife wants them to buy a new house and he's been offered a new position at work. Terry afraid to risk the security of his current position for the better-paying offer, fearful of being out of work if the new job doesn't work out.

videos.title: A Very Special World
videos.overview: On the eve of his debut as a major league baseball player, a man is committed to a tuberculosis sanatorium. He tries to adjust to his new life with the help of two women who love him.

videos.title: A Matter of Dignity
videos.overview: An arrogant man who has treated family, friends, and employees with disrespect and abuse finds his life threatened and no one to turn to for help.

videos.title: A Stone for His Son
videos.overview: Prejudice almost destroys a family when a successful rancher disowns his only son for marrying a woman who's grandmother was a Sioux. The secret of the man's bigotry is revealed because of an unexpected tragedy.

videos.title: N.Y. to L.A.
videos.overview: This show business story tells of an actor who ruthlessly pursues a studio contract with no regard for whom he steps on or uses along the way. His girlfriend is the last to realize his true nature.

videos.title: The Iron Cobweb
videos.overview: An author returns to the hospital following the loss of her new-born. While there, she realizes that someone wants to make her seem unhinged by the infant's death.

videos.title: The Tender Leaves of Hope
videos.overview: After suffering a serious accident, an accomplished surgeon fears that his skills are lost. He turns to a psychiatrist for help.

videos.title: P. J. Martin and Son
videos.overview: A domineering mother controls the family business with a steely grip--the same one she uses to control her two sons.

videos.title: The Tall Dark Man
videos.overview: A girl known for spinning fanciful stories witnesses a murder outside of her schoolroom window. Because of her reputation, no one believes her. What's worse, she realizes that the murderer saw her watching.

videos.title: Bella Fleace Gave a Party
videos.overview: Octogenarian Bella Fleace decides to have one last fling and give a great ball, but no one attends.

videos.title: The Great Gatsby
videos.overview: In an adaptation of F. Scott Fitzgerald's "roaring twenties" book, a man pines for the woman who discarded him years earlier.

videos.title: The Cage
videos.overview: In London during World War II, British counter intelligence agents track down a wily Nazi spy.

videos.title: The Drifter
videos.overview: In the Old West, a Civil War veteran and a dance hall gal are awarded a stage coach line by its dying owner.

videos.title: Now or Never
videos.overview: Jack and Liz meet on the Stamford, Connecticut express train. Through flashbacks, we learn they first met at the same location and began a torrid, though short-lived, love affair.

videos.title: The Killers
videos.overview: Guilt plagues a number of people who feel that, perhaps, their indifference was a cause for a man's death.

videos.title: Second Chance
videos.overview: A son feels so indebted to his family for having sacrificed to send him to college that he almost ruins his academic career.

videos.title: There's No Need to Shout
videos.overview: Real-life newspaperwoman Frances Warfield jeopardizes her success by not addressing her hearing loss.

videos.title: Towhead
videos.overview: The young new teacher in a small town tries to gently let down a young student who has a crush on her.

videos.title: The Fourth of July
videos.overview: A determined police detective works to force a crooked former politician to face the music.

videos.title: The Paper Hero
videos.overview: An unmarried middle-aged clerk at a marriage license bureau is a true romantic. He's always writing poems and bringing flowers for the young lovers who visit his office. He eventually falls for a widow, but starts to have second thoughts about marriage because of her superficial and self-centered ways.

videos.title: The Diamond Curtain
videos.overview: A young woman moves to New York City and becomes a success, only to become entrapped by a life of superficiality.

videos.title: Decision by Morning
videos.overview: A tough moral and professional decision faces a gifted eye surgeon. He can chose an action that may save a child's vision, but it would compromise medical standards.

videos.title: A Slightly Important Man
videos.overview: A shrewish wife considers her husband's theater career to be competition for his affections. She forces him to make a choice.

videos.title: Uncle Snowball
videos.overview: Two worldly gentlemen vie for the affections of an equally cosmopolitan woman in this light comedy.

videos.title: Late Love
videos.overview: Rosie escapes her dull life as an office secretary engaged for a decade to a dentist through her elaborate daydreams. When Rosie loses her job, she indulges her imagination by heading for Mexico armed with a Geiger counter.

videos.title: Rosie
videos.overview: An office secretary has been engaged to a dentist for 10 years. The doctor feels he must have security before he settles down to wed and start a family.

videos.title: The Return of Johnny Burro
videos.overview: One half of a once-dangerous criminal duo is now reformed. His ex-partner arrives, looking for a place to hide out for a while.

videos.title: My Dear Emily
videos.overview: In the final summer stock performance of the season, a father's extreme possessiveness of his daughter ruins her life.

videos.title: Woman in the Window
videos.overview: A reserved college professor is fascinated by the portrait of a woman that hangs near his mens' club. While admiring the picture one day, he happens to meet its gorgeous blonde subject. This leads to an invite to her apartment, some champagne, and a murder.

videos.title: Mr. and Mrs. Monroe
videos.overview: On his own while his wife's away in Europe, henpecked Mr. Monroe decides he'll be the suave and adventurous man of his imagination. In his fantasies, he captures a diamond smuggler and a dangerous escaped convict.

videos.title: Along Came Jones
videos.overview: A soft-spoken cowboy shows up in a small western town looking for work. The locals mistakenly assume he's a murderous troublemaker, causing great tension when he starts dating the real killer's girlfriend.

videos.title: The Stranger
videos.overview: Authorities hope that their release a low-level war criminal will lead them to a Nazi Germany leader who "disappeared" after World War II. Following the released man, they're led to a small Connecticut town and a respected professor.

videos.title: Paper Town
videos.overview: A family is at odds when the father, successful in the lumber business, insists his son take over the company. The son, married and expecting a child soon, wants to finish law school instead.

videos.title: Tomorrow is Forever
videos.overview: An American soldier, whose disfigured face was reconstructed by Austrian plastic surgeons, returns home after twenty years, but no one recognizes him. His widow is married to another man, and his son is a grown young man.

videos.title: Man Lost
videos.overview: A Navy man loses his will to live following the death of his wife. He witnesses an A-bomb test in the Pacific and then goes "on leave" in Hawaii where he makes positive discoveries about himself.

videos.title: In a Foreign City
videos.overview: The truth eventually catches up with a sad man when his life is revealed to have been nothing but lies.

videos.title: The World to Nothing
videos.overview: Being an incredible actor is not enough as a performer feels nothing but loneliness even though he has a wife and daughter.

videos.title: Cry Silence
videos.overview: When a farmer's young wife dies in an "accident", the local police have doubts about how accidental her death actually was.

videos.title: Isobel
videos.overview: The successful writer of detective stories is the last person to see a young woman alive. The girl, Isobel, also shares the name of the heroine in one of the author's novels.

videos.title: End of the Rainbow
videos.overview: The heads of two immigrant families feud constantly, even though they are are neighbors and work at the same factory. It's practically inevitable that two of their youngsters would fall in love.

videos.title: Lucifer
videos.overview: A publishing manager who has caused a great deal of unhappiness throughout his career gets his turn in the hot seat.

videos.title: See the Man
videos.overview: A young mechanic hides a shameful secret-- he's unable to read, having left school early because of poverty. He believe his illiteracy is standing in the way of his success.

videos.title: Quality Town
videos.overview: A man who climbed the ladder from wildcatter to oil tycoon spoils his daughter with the material things he never had.

videos.title: The Second Day of Christmas
videos.overview: This is the story of the young Hans Christian Anderson's love for singer Jenny Lind and her refusal to give up her singing career.

videos.title: Three Men from Tomorrow
videos.overview: Three individual one-act stories are told, each involving young men facing moral or ethical decisions which will have profound effects on their futures. Act one profiles a high school student who's planning to elope with his girlfriend; Act two looks at a young man who's asked to deal drugs; Act three is the story of a college fraternity president who's supposed to expel one of the brothers.

videos.title: The End of the Tether
videos.overview: An elderly mariner is making his final voyage as the captain of a non-seaworthy boat owned by shady characters. Determined to retire with his dignity, the captain takes the ragged ship out to sea with the intention of wrecking the wreck.

videos.title: The Tyrant
videos.overview: A small town newspaper editor takes a stand against a powerful local citizen who acts with dictatorial rule.

videos.title: Aftermath
videos.overview: A lawyer who finds himself at a murder scene quickly leaves town, fearing that the crime will be pinned on him. He returns five years later with a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Mr. Tutt Baits the Hook
videos.overview: Eccentric lawyer Ephriam Tutt puts his unconventional methods to use to help a young man charged with murder.

videos.title: Good Friday 1865
videos.overview: A teen-aged boy gets a bit part in a play so he can meet his idol, Abraham Lincoln. Instead, he ends up witnessing the assassination of the president at the Ford Theater.

videos.title: The Man Who Vanished
videos.overview: A middle-aged man decides that the joys of youth were preferable to the success he now enjoys in business. As he retreats into the dreams of his carefree youth, he physically begins to fade away before the eyes of his friends and associates.

videos.title: An Excuse for Shanks
videos.overview: A shy, young man in a small town has been disliked by people his whole life. He makes his first real friend, the wife of the local pool hall owner, and falls madly in love with her. Shanks unwittingly becomes a factor is his own downfall.

videos.title: End of Morning
videos.overview: A school bus driver steers his vehicle into the path of an on-coming train and four children are killed. As a man who once believed he had all of life's answers finds himself struggling to make sense of anything.

videos.title: Adam's Son
videos.overview: A judge's campaign for the governorship has his son feeling that he can never live up to his father's achievements. At least that's the case until the judge makes a serious mistake.

videos.title: The Briefcase
videos.overview: A young couple's marriage is on the rocks because of the husband's failure to get ahead at work. He encounters obstacles from an underhanded office worker in the grocery business.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: A lumberjack actively guards a mysterious black box in his possession. This piques the curiosity of the others in the logging camp. Everyone has a theory about its contents, ranging from love letters to evidence of a murder.

videos.title: The Long Way Home
videos.overview: A commuter suffers a heart attack in Grand Central Station as he's heading home to Connecticut.

videos.title: Death Insurance
videos.overview: An auto mechanic unhappy with his lot in life plans to kill his wife and collect on the insurance policy he just opened on her. When the "accident" he arranged for her fizzles, he cancels the policy. As luck would have it, his wife becomes seriously injured in a real accident. Now he's fighting to keep her alive because her recently deceased father left her a small fortune that goes to charity if she dies.

videos.title: Pistolero
videos.overview: A gas station owner in a small prairie town decides to expose the local political boss as the evil that he is. The angry strongman responds by hiring a hit man to kill the troublemaker.

videos.title: Portrait of a Man
videos.overview: The life of the genius Albert Einstein is highlighted in this biography. His early years in Prague, when he proposed his famed Theory of Relativity, are presented. The show then focuses on his later life when he lived modestly among the people of Princeton, New Jersey.

videos.title: The Baobab Tree
videos.overview: A South African plantation is home to a baobab tree, a large native plant which is said to kill all other life near it. The action centers on a woman who flirts shamelessly and the price she pays for her actions.

videos.title: Don't Do Me Any Favors
videos.overview: A singer discovers that success can carry a high price when he gets swept up by fast-talking con men. As he rises to the top, he finds the people around him are more interested in a piece of his income than in his welfare. Johnny Desmond sings "Please Don't Forget Me, Dear."

videos.title: Jack Be Nimble
videos.overview: A bigamist has two different wives in two different cities that he travels between for business. Neither knows about the other, until one fateful day. Unable to justify his behavior to either woman, he commits a crime he never thought he would have.

videos.title: The Right Thing
videos.overview: Following the death of a girl in a car accident, Bob Slater is tortured by the idea that he was somehow negligent in his driving that day.

videos.title: All Expenses Paid
videos.overview: A naive salesclerk is named "Miss Courtesy" by her store and is awarded an all-expenses paid trip to Nassau. While vacationing at the exotic locale, she falls under the spell of a suave and sophisticated man of the world.

videos.title: Who?
videos.overview: In this unusual drama, seven actors portray the same character as he's seen through the eyes of different people. The "Standard Who" is how the man sees himself, along with the "Ineffectual Who", the "Solid Who", the "Slob Who", the "Satyr Who", the "Nasty Who" and the "Godlike Who".

videos.title: Honored Guest
videos.overview: Krisons Rigo, a recent immigrant, settles in a small Long Island town. Though he taught in the old country, he cannot get a certificate here, so he takes a job as a school janitor.

videos.title: Storm Over Swan Lake
videos.overview: A teacher's opposition to dismissal by a tyrannical school superintendent throws a small town into turmoil.

videos.title: The Soldier Room
videos.overview: An unhappy wife is forbidden by her psychotic husband to even have friends. he's a man who retired early to play with his toy soldier collection. When she falls in love with another, she see the chance to leave this unhappy life behind. She's torn, however, because she knows her husband would be lost without her.

videos.title: An Elephant for Peanuts
videos.overview: A young boy nicknamed Peanuts desperately wants an elephant for a pet. He steals a purchase order from his father's work and buys a baby pachyderm that he hides in their garage.

videos.title: Dream No More
videos.overview: A college professor is obsessed with getting a piece of property owned by the mother of one of his students. He tries to charm the the property from her, before attempting to destroy the woman. The mother gets the last word, but pays a big price for it.

videos.title: A Matter of Conscience
videos.overview: A husband and wife have begun to drift apart after nine years of marriage. The husband spends more and more time at his law office, convincing his spouse that he's having an affair. She confronts him with her belief.

videos.title: Day of Grace
videos.overview: A meek editor at a religious publishing house believes that only a large sum of money could give him the life he wants and the nerve to propose to the woman he loves. Upon discovering the next day's newspaper at his doorstep, he becomes bold and aggressive trying to capitalize on the stock market and race track results the magic newspaper contains.

videos.title: Catch a Falling Star
videos.overview: Ken Reed, once a big name actor in Hollywood, refuses to accept that he's no longer the star he thinks he is. Even though he hasn't had a film role in two years, he continues to live lavishly, even refusing a supporting part on Broadway because it's beneath him. He is given one last chance at career redemption, and it hinges on a successful test for television.

videos.title: Southern Exposure
videos.overview: In this comedy set in Mississippi, an aging Southern belle grudgingly opens her mansion to tacky Yankee tourists during the annual azalea festival. Needing the money to keep the bank from foreclosing on her home, she also takes in a boarder, a young man who's written a popular but critical book about the Natchez way of life.

videos.title: Maybe Tomorrow
videos.overview: Bernice has spent her whole life working in her father's store and being dominated by her beautiful mother. When she finally finds love in the form of a salesman, her mother disapproves. Bernice is forced to choose between the man of her dreams and her controlling parent.

videos.title: The Company Wife
videos.overview: An accountant who's a rabid baseball fan is chosen to umpire the game between his office and their biggest competitor. When he makes a close call against his company's team, he finds himself a shunned outcast.

videos.title: Mr. Parker's Rhubarb
videos.overview: An accountant is picked to umpire the baseball game between his firm and it's competitor. The ump makes a critical decision against his own team and this doesn't make him a hero around the office or his home.

videos.title: Soldiers from the Wars Returning
videos.overview: In the season premiere, James Cagney plays an Army sergeant who escorts the body of a fellow sergeant to his hometown. With the Korean War long over, he finds most people disinterested and wonders if their mission was in vain.

videos.title: Onions in the Stew
videos.overview: A wife deals with maddening problems running a household on an island not far off the coast from Seattle. In this comic tale, the mother deals with two teen-aged daughters, plumbing that doesn't work, and a friend with eyes on their housekeeper.

videos.title: After All These Years
videos.overview: A wife wakes up to find that her husband has left her and their home behind for no apparent reason. She later learns of the crisis that plagues some men in the later years of marriage.

videos.title: Last Trip of the Hindenburg
videos.overview: The stories of various passengers are told in this semi-documentary about the trans-Atlantic crossing of the Hindenburg, including its tragic landing in New Jersey.

videos.title: September Affair
videos.overview: After a plane crashes into the Atlantic, two of the passengers listed as dead survive, fall in love, and decide to stay together in Europe, leaving their former lives and responsibilities back home.

videos.title: Pilgrimage
videos.overview: The wife of a doctor who's devoted his work to public health feels he's a fool for not going into private practice where he can make more money. When she eventually leaves him, the doctor decides he's had enough of the big city and its so-called sophistication. He heads for the Caribbean to set up a public health station.

videos.title: Goodbye, Grey Flannel
videos.overview: A brilliant Madison Avenue ad man had tired of the pressure, so he and his wife retire to the supposedly serene life of a Vermont apple farmer. His first crop of motley-looking fruit tasted great, so he wrote an advertisement singing the praises of spotted apples. Soon, he had organized his fellow farmers into an association and was running an ad agency out of his house.

videos.title: One Bright Day
videos.overview: The president of a drug company returns from Europe to an awaiting lawsuit alleging that one of their medicines killed a boy. After being convinced of the drug's toxicity, he must choose to either to directly alert the public or, as others at the firm suggest, quietly remove it from the market.

videos.title: Mr. Tutt Goes West
videos.overview: The eccentric lawyer of "Saturday Evening Post"-fame fights the shady owner of a small town Montana store. The crooked proprietor is trying to cheat a mining engineer out of his dig.

videos.title: The Misfortunes of Mr. Minihan
videos.overview: Mr. Minihan is a man who spreads unhappiness and trouble wherever he goes, through no fault of his own. Consequently, no matter how much his friends love him, they they are forced to devise schemes to send him far away.

videos.title: Plainfield Teachers College
videos.overview: A fictitious college team has its scores printed in the newspaper every week. It's a scam to help out a guy who's in trouble with a bookie.

videos.title: Sunset Boulevard
videos.overview: In this adaptation of the 1950 film, an opportunist writer grudgingly plays love interest to delusional silent film star Nora Desmond. In her fantasy world she's still the world's biggest star and throngs of adoring fans are awaiting her big comeback.

videos.title: The Young and the Beautiful
videos.overview: A teen-aged girl plays the part of a sophisticated flirt, pursuing one young man after another. As soon as one becomes interested, she drops him and moves on to the next one.

videos.title: Miracle at Lensham
videos.overview: An American film star, on location in Britain, makes a $50 donation to a run-down church. When the money disappears, a furor follows with the church receiving much publicity. Soon, tourists are flocking to the chapel and donations are pouring in.

videos.title: Amahl and the Night Visitors
videos.overview: This annual live presentation of the opera is telecast in color on this series. Amahl, a disabled young peasant boy, tells his widowed mother that he's just seen a magnificent star in the sky. Soon, there's a knock at their door. Three kings on a long journey arrive at their door asking for a place to rest. They are carrying with them gifts to present to the Christ Child. Wanting to send a gift, but being very poor, Amahl has only his crutch to give.

videos.title: Music for Your New Year's Eve
videos.overview: Robert Montgomery drops the usual dramatic format for an evening of live music.

videos.title: The Liar
videos.overview: A young wife's apparent inability to tell the truth is putting her marriage in jeopardy.

videos.title: Give and Take
videos.overview: A tragic woman feels she's adding nothing to her family and following the loss of an expected child, her mental condition slips further.

videos.title: Crisis at Sand Cave
videos.overview: Searching for another entrance to the Mammoth Cave system, Kentucky spelunker Floyd Collins became trapped just 150 feet from the entrance of Sand Cave. Rescuers were able to feed and talk with Collins before additional cave-ins allowed only voice contact. The two weeks of daily coverage by reporter William Burke Miller helped fuel a media circus that surrounded the rescue attempts.

videos.title: The Clay Pigeon
videos.overview: Since he works for his older brother, a test pilot always feels he's in his elder's shadow. He doesn't show up for work one day, forcing the older brother to conduct a test flight. When something goes wrong in the plane and he's killed, the family holds the younger brother responsible for his death.

videos.title: The Week the World Stood Still
videos.overview: Swedish industrialist Birger Dahlerus worked frantically in the week preceding the start of World War II to negotiate a deal between Britain and Germany. This is a dramatization of the actual events leading up to the outbreak of war.

videos.title: The Grand Prize
videos.overview: Secretary Lucille Cotton's prize from a TV contest is to be the boss of her boss for 24 hours. At first, her employer likes the idea because he'll have more time for flirting with her. He changes his opinion when she starts doing some serious bossing.

videos.title: Wait for Me
videos.overview: A teenage girl with an older sister tries to spread her wings and become more independent.

videos.title: Reclining Figure
videos.overview: A wealthy American art collector is anxious to get his hands on a valuable Renoir painting.

videos.title: The Enemy
videos.overview: When an American sailor is washed ashore during World War II, a young Japanese doctor and his wife face a crisis. They must choose between honoring their loyalty to their country or their fellow man.

videos.title: Last Train to Kildevil
videos.overview: A couple deals with a business and marital crisis while on the commute between their house and Manhattan.

videos.title: His Name was Death
videos.overview: After successfully murdering his wife, a man starts to think of himself as an expert at the craft. Soon, his friends and neighbors are dropping dead at a startling rate.

videos.title: One Minute to Ditch
videos.overview: Based on a recent actual event, a pilot performs a heroic feat when he successfully ditches his plane in the Pacific Ocean with 31 passengers on board. The U. S. Coast Guard cutter Pontchartrain arrives and rescues the survivors.

videos.title: A Slice of Life
videos.overview: In this comedy, a grandmother gets into the cupid business and it ends up turning her home into a commercial bakery.

videos.title: Victoria Regina
videos.overview: Claire Bloom portrays the famed Queen Victoria over a 60 year span, from the age of 18 through her romance with Prince Albert through her diamond jubilee in 1897.

videos.title: Fear Street
videos.overview: Two brothers -- one a police officer, the other a gangster -- face off in a mortal battle. The woman they both love decides the outcome.

videos.title: The Trial of Pontius Pilate
videos.overview: This is a dramatization of the events surrounding the trial of Jesus. Pontius Pilate finds Jesus not guilt yet still turns him over the angry crowd which crucifies him. At his own trial at Nero's court in Rome, he tries to justify his actions.

videos.title: The New World
videos.overview: This suspense drama is based on the actual events involving the scientists working secretly at Chicago's Stagg Field. Dramatized are the final weeks leading up to the first successful nuclear chain reaction, an achievement that made the atomic bomb possible.

videos.title: Longing for to Go
videos.overview: This love story revolves around an attractive assistant director in television and her boss, an egomaniacal director.

videos.title: Return Visit
videos.overview: Now that he's become successful in the New York business world, a man returns to his hometown to see the friends and family he once rejected.

videos.title: Sturdevant's Daughter
videos.overview: A daughter fears that her mother is falling in love with their family's doctor, so she gets involved to save her parents' marriage.

videos.title: One Smart Apple
videos.overview: In a sequel to the episode "Goodbye, Grey Flannel" (10/22/56), the characters return to teach a few things to the big city advertising types of New York. The Vermont farmer's daughter coaching the husband-hunters "city girls" a few things about catching men.

videos.title: The Weather Lover
videos.overview: In this fantasy, a man who's able to control the weather of the world reaches too far when he tries to do the same with love. He employs his weather-manipulating skills to come between a husband and wife and their daughter and her boyfriend.

videos.title: Faust '57
videos.overview: A modern adaptation of the opera Faust closes out the Robert Montgomery series. Faust, the scientist, sells his soul to Satan in exchange for the element he needs to complete a scientific formula. This item, however, proves to be useless to him.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 win & 2 nominations total
